rv.q: Both Züchner and Schneider entrance audiences with their embodiments of Karajan and Bernstein, respectively, and Last Call is worth seeing for the wig work of Justen Brosnan alone.
Alas, all this fanboy knowledge has not necessarily translated into convincing drama .

vr.q: I became bored because there wasn't an objective really for these men to work for other than just wanting to one up the other and be right and it wasn't funny enough to at least hold on my interest that way
